text:
To configure Hermes Agent to use Ollama and prevent it from attempting to route to remote providers (which is causing the 401 authentication and fallback errors), update your `~/.hermes/config.yaml` file:

### For Local Ollama:
Set your default model, force the custom provider endpoint, and clear `fallback_providers`:

```yaml
model:
  default: ollama/your-model
  provider: custom
  base_url: http://localhost:11434
fallback_providers: []
```

---

### For Ollama Cloud:
If you are using Ollama's cloud service instead, configure it with:

```yaml
model:
  default: your-model
  provider: ollama-cloud
  base_url: https://ollama.com/v1
fallback_providers: []
```

### Additional Tips for Local Models:
- If running smaller models (4B–9B) feels slow due to the token overhead of Hermes tool schemas, run `hermes tools` to disable unused toolsets, use faster quantizations, or set `terminal.backend: local`.
- If your custom model supports vision, include `supports_vision: true` in your custom model configuration.
